The House Committee on Agriculture Bill 91 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Cooper of the 45th, Carpenter of the 4th, Jasperse of the 11th, Dickey of the 134th, and Consumer Affairs offers Camp of the following substitute to HB 91: 135th
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 3 of Chapter 50 of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to licensing, so as to provide for licensure for graduates of foreign colleges … veterinarian;"
SECTION 3. This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law without such approval.
SECTION 4. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
